answer: Split-tally bond blocks bulk fake identities: every identity splits a tally stick, keeps the key-signed half, and files the other for a 70-credit bond. Filing burns a 35-credit nectar fee. Auditors match halves per epoch; a missing, reused, or rented half burns the bond and leaves a plume record. That starts a ripple audit. 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 x 105 = 105,000 credits, over twice the 40,000 pool. Honest ones pay 35 once and keep their bond.
